744.description: Setsuna is a Shinmeiryu swordswoman from Kyoto who was taken in by Eishun Konoe, Konoka's father and the leader of the Kyoto Mage Association. She is childhood friends with Konoka and her protector.  Setsuna spends the beginning of the series being relatively cold to Konoka, wishing to protect her from the shadows due to not forgiving herself for being unable to save Konoka when she almost drowned when they were kids. She does eventually open up to Konoka after the Kyoto arc and begins calling her "Oujo-sama" and "Kono-chan".  Setsuna's pactio, Sica Shishikushiro is a wakizashi which she can summon and multiply at will to strike targets like missiles. Due to her training she's also skilled in anti-demon arts and is the one who taught Negi how to create shikigami from paper.  Setsuna is a hanyou like Koutaro, in particular a crow. She was expelled from her people because white wings are considered a bad omen, and it was implied by Evangeline that she is an albino using hair dye and contact lenses to appear human.  A running gag within the series is that Setsuna and Konoka appear to have romantic feelings for one another, yet Setsuna will deny it whenever she and Konoka are stumbled upon in romantic situations or asked about her preference.

name.native: エヴァンジェリン・A.K.・マクダウェル

953.description:
__Seat Number:__ 26
__Clubs:__ Go Club, Tea Ceremony Club
__Height:__ 130 cm (4'3")

Evangeline is a centuries-old true blood vampire, cursed to remain at the school by [Nagi Springfield](https://anilist.co/character/4912/Springfield-Nagi). Initially an antagonist for [Negi](https://anilist.co/character/146/Springfield-Negi) due to his father's actions, she eventually becomes an important teacher and guide for the young mage and his allies. However, Eva remains a cruel, powerful mage in her own right, yet with the sensitivities of her former human life. Evangeline, having the reputation of a coldblooded killer, is feared in the magic side of the world. The legends surrounding her have gained her many monikers such as the Advent of Evil, the Apostle of Calamity, the Doll Master, and the Gospel of Darkness.

In UQ Holder, a semi-sequel set 70 years into the future, she takes on the form of a tall woman and the alias Yukihime. She is the foster mother to Touta, Negi's grandson, and is the leader of UQ Holder-- an organization comprised of immortals and other monsters that aid their brethren and outcast humans.

954.description:
__Seat Number:__ 27

Class 2/3-A's resident bookworm, Nodoka is of the quiet but kind variety, harboring romantic feelings for her homeroom teacher, Negi Springfield. She has since confessed her feelings to him, but not much progress in their relationship has been made; they still remain friends. Nodoka is the second person to establish a probationary contract with Negi and gain a pactio card (it occured during the field trip to Kyoto). Her artifact is a book that can show one's thoughts in picture diary format.

991.description:
__Seat Number:__ 4

Yue is Nodoka's best friend, and is often seen around both her and Haruna. She's short and at times has a blunt way of speaking to people, but is generally a friendly person. She likes to read but (ironically) doesn't like to study, and is one of the Baka Rangers (a name for the 5 worst students in Negi's class). When she finds out that Negi is a mage she gets excited about learning magic herself.  At first she shows no romantic interest in Negi, but as time goes by she finds herself developing a crush on him. However she doesn't want to hurt Nodoka, so she tries to keep it bottled up as much as she can. She's supportive of Nodoka and wishes her the best of luck when it comes to her and Negi's relationship.  Yue became the 5th person in Negi's class to make a Pactio with him, following Asuna, Nodoka, Setsuna, and Konoka.

1018.description:
D is a dhampir, the half-breed child of a vampire father the legendary Vampire lord and human mother, therefore he makes the ideal vampire hunter. He is renowned for his consummate skill and unearthly grace, but feared and despised for his mixed lineage: born of both races but belonging to neither. Often underestimated by his opponents, D has surprising power and resourcefulness, possessing most of the strengths and only mild levels of vampiric weaknesses. Unlike most dhampirs, D is able to live as a "normal" human, though marked by his unearthly beauty and powerful aura, and thus rarely accepted by humans.

His only notable weaknesses are that he is, while not unfeeling, emotionally remote but sometimes sentimental. He is also (far more rarely than other dhampirs) randomly susceptible to sun-sickness, a severe type of sunstroke, about once every five years. Otherwise, D does not suffer from vampiric weaknesses usual to dhampirs, possessing an imposing supernatural aura to his opponents and godlike reflexes surpassing even vampires.

(Source: Wikipedia)

1019.description: D's constant companion is his talking left hand, sometimes reffered to as the Countenanced Carbuncle. It is revealed that this is some sort of symbiotic entity which has taken up residence in D's hand, although why he has done so is not clear. The hand (or 'Lefty' as fans have affectionately termed him) appears to have supernatural powers independent from his host, and occasionally uses them to help D. More often than not, however, Lefty generally prefers sitting back and letting D do the work, usually throwing in a sarcastic comment or two at D's expense.   (Source: Vampire Hunter D wikia)

1020.description: Conspicuous as the sole woman of the group [The Marcus Brothers], although she isn't related by blood to the Marcus Brothers, they consider her their little sister. She fights using a very powerful gun. Leila joined the Marcus Brothers to avenge her parents, as her father was killed trying to rescue her mother from vampires, who in turn, turned her into a vampire too. The town's people stoned Leila's mother to death while a young Leila watched, helpless (Wiki).

1021.description: Meier Link is an extremely powerful "vampire knight" who is being hunted by both D and the Marcus Brothers for kidnapping Charlotte.    Meier has the ability to change his long cape into steel with razor sharp edges, and his skill in using it matches D's skill with the sword.

name.native: シャーロット・エルバーン

1022.description: Charlotte Elbourne was the girl that was thought to be kidnapped by Meier. Later it is revealed that she and Meier were actually in love and were running away to be together.    Charlotte wanted Meier to turn her into a vampire, but Meier refused to do so. They planned to use Carmilla's spaceship to escape into space.    (source: Absolute Anime)

1023.description: Kyle Markus is a team member in a group of professional vampire hunters widely known as "The Marcus Brothers". The four Marcus brothers are all related except Leila, however they still treat her like a younger sister.    Kyle has a very aloof personality and is quite confident in himself. He get excited easily when a bounty is spotted and enjoys attacking with his cross-shaped blades made of silver which he carries everywhere.    He has been known to flirt with Leila, but just for a tease.    (source: Absolute Anime)

1024.description: Grove: The fourth brother, he is bed-ridden and is capable of astrally projecting his soul and dealing massive psychic attacks after receiving a special injection. In the movie, Grove is very close to Leila.  Source: Wikipedia

1025.description: A shroud-encased mutant with a warped sense of humor and a kabuki-like white face and hands.     He crafts illusions and ensnares D with a dramatic time-space warping trap. He can expand and flatten himself into a shadow-like darkness, he can move along inside shadows and can actually kill a being by attacking their shadows.

1026.description: The eldest of the Marcus Brothers and apparent leader, Borgoff carries a powerful wrist-mounted crossbow. Borgoff is incredibly skilled at using the crossbow, to such an extent that he can manually reload and fire the crossbow so rapidly that he can create a literal rain of silver bolts.    Borgoff and his brothers were hired to chase Meier Link, who had kidnapped Charlotte. Of all the brothers, Borgoff was the only one who thought it beneficial to work with D in capturing Merier Link rather than against him.
